questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to emphasise the subject in a hypothetical context?
options: If you had more time, you would finish the project sooner.
Only when the storm passes will the airport reopen.
Never have I seen such a well-cooked meal before.
Had she known the truth, she would have reacted differently.
questions.answer: Only when the storm passes will the airport reopen.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft construction to highlight the object of the sentence?
options: It was the decision that caused the most controversy among the team.
The reason for the failure was the lack of proper planning.
What surprised me most was how quickly she recovered.
The issue that divided them was their differing views on ethics.
questions.answer: What surprised me most was how quickly she recovered.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical scenario involving a hypothetical situation?
options: If I were you, I would avoid that risky investment.
She insisted that he had left the documents in the office.
Unless he arrives by midnight, we will have to postpone the meeting.
They demanded that the contract be signed immediately.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would avoid that risky investment.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses ellipsis to imply a repeated structure, maintaining formal register?
options: She came first, second, and third in the competition.
He often complains about the weather, the traffic, and the noise.
The meeting was held in London, Paris, and Berlin last year.
The book was written in 2010, published in 2012, and reviewed in 2015.
questions.answer: The book was written in 2010, published in 2012, and reviewed in 2015.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly combines two complex clauses with a nuanced conditional structure, requiring advanced syntax?
options: Although the evidence was inconclusive, they still proceeded with caution.
Had he known the truth sooner, he would have acted differently at the time.
If she had not been so tired, she would have finished the report by now.
Whenever he feels stressed, he prefers to spend time alone reading.
questions.answer: Had he known the truth sooner, he would have acted differently at the time.
